name: Licita
tagline: Stay legal from seed to shelf — even at home.
positioning: Licita turns confusing state cannabis rules into a plain checklist, so individual growers and small operators never miss a plant count, tag, or renewal.

hero.h1: Know your grow is legal, plant by plant.
hero.sub: Licita reads your state's cannabis rules and hands you a plain checklist — plant counts, canopy limits, tag logs, and renewal dates — so you never guess whether you're compliant.

features.title: Plant-by-plant ledger
features.description: Log every seed, clone, and harvest with photos and dates. When an inspector asks for your seed-to-sale trail, you export a clean PDF in one tap.

features.title: State rule engine
features.description: Pick your state and grow type. Licita tracks your legal plant count, canopy square footage, and possession limits and warns you before you cross a line.

features.title: Renewal reminders
features.description: Medical cards, cultivation permits, and METRC tags all expire on different days. We surface the next deadline and email you 30, 14, and 3 days out.

features.title: Tag reconciliation
features.description: Match physical plant tags against your digital log so a missing or duplicated tag never turns into a violation notice at renewal time.

features.title: Audit-ready exports
features.description: Generate the exact recordkeeping packet your state requires — movement history, waste logs, and weights — formatted the way regulators expect.

features.title: Weight & waste tracking
features.description: Record wet and dry weights plus disposal reasons. Licita flags gaps in your chain so your numbers always add up under review.

testimonials.quote: I grow six plants for my medical card and I used to lie awake wondering if I'd logged everything right. Licita's checklist told me exactly what my state needed. My last renewal took ten minutes.
testimonials.name: Dana Reyes

testimonials.quote: We run a four-person craft cultivation permit. The tag reconciliation caught two mislabeled plants before an inspection that would have cost us the license. It has paid for itself many times over.
testimonials.name: Marcus Feld

testimonials.quote: Before Licita our waste logs were a shoebox of receipts. Now the weight tracking matches our disposal records automatically, and the export is exactly what our compliance officer signs off on.
testimonials.name: Priya Anand

pricing.blurb: For patients and personal cultivators tracking a handful of plants.
For craft growers and micro-permits that face real inspections.
For multi-site operators and co-ops with dedicated compliance staff.

homepage.footerBlurb: Licita is recordkeeping software, not legal advice. Always confirm requirements with your state cannabis authority.
